summary: Add host-local PATCH to rename or redescribe a retained stopped snapshot on the pool master's catalog without changing digests or disk identity.

guide.reason: Operators can rename or redescribe a retained point through the host-local API; the snapshots guide documents the steps.

api.reason: Adds PATCH /api/local/v1/pool/vms/{id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id} and the peer master action snapshot-metadata. Capture digests and creation time stay fixed; later revert/delete bind the updated descriptor digest.

roadmap.reason: Advances in-progress S2 metadata; Phase 5 status unchanged until Controller UI and remaining acceptance close.

state.record: Pool master's pool-vms.json snapshot catalog name and description for the existing snapshot ID; fresh Controller adopts catalog rows from ManagedState.pool_vm_snapshots.
state.reason: Controller only displays host-reported catalog entries.

verification.method: Focused Go unit and CSRF route tests. Disposable lab on Core2 owner: create then PATCH renamed the retained point with unchanged digests. Raw lab receipts under .cache were wiped after the session; results remain in the snapshots guide verification notes and browser QA.
